thought.text: The `.localhost` TLD isn't resolving in this container's resolver (getent doesn't map it to 127.0.0.1). The proxy is up on port 80. Let me test with explicit Host headers.

reasoning_content:
The proxy is up on port 80. The `*.localhost` names aren't resolving via getent because this environment's resolver doesn't handle `.localhost`. Let me use `--resolve` or Host header directly to test.

Actually the proxy returns 200 at `/`. Let me test with Host header.

action.command: for h in api.workspace.localhost keycloak.workspace.localhost meilisearch.workspace.localhost mailpit.workspace.localhost localstack.workspace.localhost; do echo -n "$h => "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Host: $h" http://127.0.0.1/; done; echo "=== api health ==="; curl -s -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1/health; echo; echo "=== keycloak realm ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1/realms/swcode
